tasks.title: Fix routing JSONL sprint_id — stamp from sprint file path in loadTasks()

issues.description: File contains only 4 lines of commentary instead of the required ~2865-line orchestrator. The entire implementation has been discarded. This is a total regression — 99.86% of the file is missing.
The requested bugfix (stamping sprint_id onto tasks in loadTasks() by deriving it from process.argv[2]) was not implemented at all. The 3-line addition was never made.
The file is non-functional — it cannot be executed as a TypeScript module. All agent orchestration logic, task loading, routing, event bus integration, and everything else is gone.

File shrank from 2865 lines to 441 lines. Task spec explicitly states 'This is a 3-line addition to the 2864-line orchestrator — no rewrites.' The generated output is a destructive rewrite that removes 2424 lines of existing functionality.

Task requirement not met: sprint_id derivation from process.argv[2] was not added to loadTasks() normalization. The bugfix (3-line addition using the pattern at lines 2205-2206 and 2262-2263) is missing entirely.
File contains integrity check comment instead of actual code. This is a placeholder, not a valid implementation.
